steps.label: Force
steps.sub: pin the better historical plan directly from the report

code:
WITH recent AS (
  SELECT plan_id, avg_duration
  FROM sys.query_store_runtime_stats rs
  JOIN sys.query_store_runtime_stats_interval rsi
    ON rs.runtime_stats_interval_id
     = rsi.runtime_stats_interval_id
  WHERE rsi.start_time >
    DATEADD(DAY, -1, SYSUTCDATETIME())
)
SELECT * FROM recent
WHERE avg_duration > 0
ORDER BY avg_duration DESC;
caption: Recent window vs. baseline window — the same pattern SSMS uses.
